descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S06 How a task got its state × context → where it shows on the screen and in Copy Text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Standard fixture (one Hospital patient, one Nursing Home resident); the agent adds four tasks by hand on each chart

When A stays open; B is ticked done on the Task Export screen; C is ticked done on the chart's Post-Round tab; D is ticked done and then undone on Task Export; then Copy Text (read by the scripted step). Same in Nursing Home

Then Table: open (A) → pending under its patient; done on Task Export (B) → completed at the bottom; done on the chart (C) → completed at the bottom; done then undone (D) → pending, not completed. Copy Text follows the same table

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Decision table from U2/U3. Each view checkpoint: mustContain A–D and the patient; A and D before B and C (mustAppearInOrder, one patient, so Q5-neutral). Each clipboard checkpoint (capture: scripted): same; B and C missing reported as known (PR #106), also in the pairs that name them (oracleRules 1)

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
